derivation: The generator appended five existing 600000.SH rows straight to the rq.bars partition file, bypassing RuntimeStore.write's key de-duplication, and recorded them in benchmark/data/duplicate-keys-small/fixture.json.

ground_truth.cause: a completed write replayed into the same partition

bars_quality.note: Reachable through data.validate with no extra flags; duplicate keys are detected unconditionally.

common_failure_modes: Reading the extra rows as real sessions, a corporate action, or an intraday split.
Calling the duplicates harmless because downstream queries de-duplicate on read.
Running a sync to 'refresh' the dataset without authorization.
Missing the re-execution implication: a resumed or retried sync that replays a finished batch double-counts these sessions.
